content.short: Kulipa enables wallets to issue branded crypto debit and prepaid cards to their users.
content.description: Self-custodial wallets often face suboptimal monetization, underutilized assets, and reactive product roadmaps, which can cause missed opportunities to move funds. Kulipa provides a global payment platform that lets wallets issue branded crypto debit and prepaid cards, embedding payments into users' daily lives. These cards drive twice as much fund movement, accelerate user growth, and open a new revenue stream for wallets.
